description: Issue #149 (ADR adr-scope-derivation.md, layer L2), the BACKWARD-COMPATIBILITY half of a two-point measurement: a profile that does NOT declare `scope_companions` plans exactly as it did before L2 existed. The golden was generated by the 0.24.0 runner (段1+段3, before this feature) and is checked in unchanged, so any byte L2 adds to a profile-less plan — an echoed empty key, a re-ordered scope_defaults, a normalized default — fails here. Every profile in the wild today is this shape, so this case is what makes "未指定＝段1 までの挙動" a property rather than an intention.
